binding_contract.rule: Verify the exact LFS object SHA-256 and byte size, then stream-extract exactly one regular member whose basename and declared size equal the case record; reject links, directories, additional members, path components, truncation, and trailing member ambiguity.
binding_contract.preexisting_extracted_file_policy: A pre-existing extracted VTU is not asserted equivalent unless it is re-extracted from the verified archive or its optional SHA-256 is compared with a SHA-256 streamed from that verified archive member.

volume_stencil_source_content_attestatio.chain_sha256_rule: sha256(utf8(case_id receipt_sha256 record_sha256 audit_sha256 payload_sha256 source_content_sha256 + newline) in inventory case order)
volume_stencil_source_content_attestatio.source_hash_origin: Each receipt-bound stencil record reports the SHA-256 streamed over the complete source volume VTU by the original stencil generator.

case_set.case_ordering: geometry_id ascending, then numeric AoA ascending
